verdict.rationale: Marqeta is a hosted card-issuing platform, and a product of this kind could plausibly publish its source under an open license, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no open-source repository or license. The 'open APIs' marketing phrase means publicly callable APIs, not readable source code, so it is an adjacent claim and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
